thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-prod-eu - high 5xx rate (trigger: error-rate > 2% over 1m)
Aisha Khan: seeing it. Confirming which route is affected — /v1/generate-eu?
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty incident INC-987654 triggered and assigned to Aisha Khan (primary). Escalation policy: 5m -> secondary (Tom Rivera) -> manager (Jun Park).
Aisha Khan: I can't access the autoscaling group UI from phone, starting quick checks on SSH.
Aisha Khan: running `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-proxy -o wide`
Aisha Khan: logs show a spike of 502/503 from proxy 3/6, upstream (model-servers) returning timeouts.
Aisha Khan: hitting the model server directly with a small health probe: `curl -sS -m 2 http://10.2.7.4:8080/health` returns timeout.
Tom Rivera: pinged, en route. Secondary acked the PD page. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation timer: 4m remaining to manager. No manager ack yet.
Nora Li: customer ops ping — are we seeing user-facing errors or degraded latency? I can triage messages in support.
Aisha Khan: onboarding customers are seeing errors; support ticket count up ~ 12 in the last 10m. Adding note to incident: potential user impact.
Jun Park: sorry, in a meeting. Trying to join now. If I don't get PD call, delegate.
Aisha Khan: quick mitigation: moving traffic off eu pool to us-east fallback for non‑pinned customers. Will update routing policy.
Aisha Khan: running `redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/generate-eu --fallback us-east --dry-run` then applying.
Aisha Khan: applied. Starting gradual reroute (20% -> 50% -> 100%) to avoid cache cold-starts.
Tom Rivera: I see proxy logs: TLS handshake errors to model servers + connection resets. Could be certificate rotation or upstream network flakiness. Checking node-metrics.
Aisha Khan: temporarily bumped model-server replicas in eu: `kubectl -n model scale deploy/model-server --replicas=6` to buy us capacity while routing shifts.
Nora Li: updated support thread: advised customers we are rerouting traffic, reduced error rate expected; monitoring for false positives.
PagerDuty Bot: Alert auto-escalation: manager Jun Park notified. PD shows Jun reached via mobile, no ack yet.
Jun Park: joined. quick question — any indication of rollout/infra change in last 30m?
Aisha Khan: nothing from deploys channel, verified no recent merges to model infra. Suspect sudden network flaps in eu cloud region.
Tom Rivera: confirmed there are increased packet drops on two hosts in eu-2 pool. I'm cordoning the nodes and draining pods: `kubectl cordon eu-node-17` then `kubectl drain eu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets`
Aisha Khan: after drain, model requests on remaining pods recovered latency from 800ms -> 120ms. Errors dropping.
Nora Li: support sees errors falling from 24 tickets -> 3 active. Notifying a handful of affected customers with ETA 15-30m.
Jun Park: good mitigation. Let's keep PD incident open until all nodes replaced and traffic stabilizes. Set follow-up postmortem to include detection window and escalation latency.
Aisha Khan: agree. I'm going to replace eu-node-17 and eu-node-21 with fresh instances, and mark the incident status in the incident checklist.
Tom Rivera: acknowledge bridge setup? I created a temporary Zoom + pinned notes in incident doc.
Aisha Khan: joining bridge now. Quick note: update alert thresholds to suppress noisy proxy-level transient blips (will propose changes in postmortem).
incident-bot: Incident INC-987654 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (errors reduced, auto-reroute active). Incident will remain open pending node replacement and final verification.
Jun Park: thanks team. Once nodes replaced and 30m stable, handoff to eng-sre for cleanup and postmortem.
Aisha Khan: handing off to Tom for follow-up tasks. I'll update PD incident description with runbook steps executed.
Tom Rivera: taking follow-up. Will post a closure update once nodes are healthy and PD incident is closed.
Nora Li: confirming customer notifications sent. Will add list to incident doc.
Aisha Khan: final quick log snippet for the postmortem: ```
Apr 12 20:11:03 proxy-3 ERROR upstream timeout id=xyz request=/v1/generate
Apr 12 20:12:10 node eu-node-17 kernel: network: dropped 255 packets on eth1
```
Tom Rivera: thanks, closing loop. PD incident will be resolved after 30m stable. :white_check_mark:
